label: Ultra-thin Half Canvas
description: Ultra-thin half canvas uses an exceptionally lightweight horsehair and linen canvas restricted to the chest and lapel zone, approaching the featherweight territory of Neapolitan unstructured tailoring while retaining a soft chest shape. The jacket drapes with a whisper of form, moving almost like a shirt on the body, making it ideal for tropical and super-lightweight fabrics where any additional mass would be suffocating. The chest maintains a subtle convex curve but the overall silhouette is deliberately understated and fluid.
